title: Implement the D023 advisory identity boundary in the core
objective: Let eligibility return labelled unverified candidates for advisory routing while comparison and accounting stay strict.
acceptance: Implement the S01 section of 02_analysis/native-adapter-plan.md and decision D023, writing each failing test first.
An unverified candidate carries an explicit identity status, ranks below verified candidates and appears only when every other eligibility check passes.
Keep configured-only exclusion and the paired resolved id and version rule; add a test that no configured value is copied into a resolved field.
Comparison and accounting remain strict; an unverified profile reports an identity-specific reason, not context_first_selection_mismatch.
Show the identity status in CLI eligibility output; preserve existing databases, event schemas and tests; pass focused and full checks.
non_goals: Adapters, process spawning, adoption recording, dispatch, new dependencies, statistics changes or packaging.
